title: Cheap Car Challenge DRAMA, Is Jackstand's NEW Engine Legal?

context.edition: CRC 2 per caller labelling = Sick Summer leg of the $7,500 challenge (budget now $10,000 total incl. Sick Week spend); <10 days before Sick Summer
context.edition_note: Same cars as crc1_* (B9BPtlgCxy8); crc2_* = Sick Summer build snapshot.

rules.fact: Victor (drag-strip co-owner, shop owner, racer) appointed budget administrator; his call is final
Budget covers the car and its parts only, not hotels/food
Broken parts may be replaced with identical parts at no cost; improvements must be paid
Total budget $10,000 (original $7,500 + $2,500 for Sick Summer), counting what was already spent
Marketplace purchases count at price paid; parts pulled from shop/garage at fair market value; new sponsored/free parts at 50% of retail
Safety equipment not counted (administrator decides); upgraded brakes count as safety
Labor (own or others') does not count
Selling a part credits its sale price to the budget, but its replacement must be paid from budget; a sold engine forfeits free like-for-like replacement
